pages.lesson:
LESSON: KUSOMA 3.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA NOVELA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: UHURU WA WANYAMA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Ujifu
Topic 3.2: Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya novela ili kuipambanua
2. kujadili sifa za novela kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya novela ili kuipambanua
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya novela ili kuipambanua. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kujadili sifa za novela kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili sifa za novela kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya novela ili kuipambanua

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya novela ili kuipambanua
2. kujadili sifa za novela kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
